activity.notes: Wilhelm II became both German Emperor and King of Prussia on 15 June 1888. ATLAS records the Prussian kingship separately because the Kingdom of Prussia remained a distinct constituent monarchy within the German Empire. The Activity ends with the collapse of monarchical authority on 9 November 1918, matching the effective endpoint used for his imperial reign.

sources.title: Wilhelm II — Deutsches Historisches Museum
sources.citation_text: The Deutsches Historisches Museum identifies Wilhelm II as German Emperor and King of Prussia from his accession on 15 June 1888 until the November Revolution of 1918.
